source.title: Rostrolateral prefrontal cortex involvement in relational integration during reasoning.

confidence_rationale: fMRI on Raven-style 0-, 1- and 2-relational problems found prefrontal recruitment specific to the 2- vs 1-relational contrast, with left rostrolateral PFC (lateral area 10) remaining selective even when RT and accuracy were matched. This is the standard anchor for relational integration as a separable component process, which is the core operation structure-mapping needs. Held near 0.5 because the task is matrix reasoning, not cross-domain analogy, and a separable activation does not show a dedicated mapping operator.
failure_signatures: Relational integration on Raven matrices is within-domain pattern completion; it is not the cross-domain source-to-target mapping MECH-421 asserts, so a positive here can be read as more support than it is.

RLPFC selectivity may reflect generic manipulation of self-generated information (the authors' own suggestion) rather than anything relation-specific, which would make the region a working-memory resource, not an analogy substrate.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Considering multiple relations simultaneously (relational integration) is a component of complex reasoning that selectively recruits bilateral rostrolateral PFC and right DLPFC; left RLPFC stays selective for 2-relational problems after matching for RT and accuracy.
mapping.ree_translation: Biological grounding for the claim that relational structure is processed as structure, separately from single-relation retrieval: the brain treats 'hold two relations and align them' as a distinct load. That is the operation MECH-421 needs on top of MECH-419/MECH-420.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Says nothing about surface-dissimilar domains (containment vs inclusion, support vs commitment). A regional activation difference does not settle Q-074: RLPFC could be a general integration resource that a traversal-based analogy would also use.
mapping.source_context: Event-related fMRI, healthy adults, problems adapted from Raven's Progressive Matrices at three relational levels.

confidence_components.notes: Well-cited early fMRI study, modest sample; maps onto relational integration, not analogy across domains.
